memories.content: The 5,000 subscribers have varying levels of interest in Tidepool's product. Some may open and click emails from Tidepool; others may not. They have no prior knowledge of the beta waitlist.

Tidepool will send a beta launch email to its 5,000 newsletter subscribers on the morning of 2026-09-22. The email contains a personal note from the founder and a waitlist link above the fold. The typical click-through rate for Tidepool's newsletters is 6%.
